final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS zoneref, t.riskeval AS riskeval, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avgp, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scans s JOIN sites t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.riskeval), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM s1) SELECT s1.zoneref, s1.riskeval, s1.avgp, s1.n, CAST(s1.n AS REAL) / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
